updates.sentence: 262 months (21 years, 10 months) after resentencing; this imposed term is not actual time served. The Tenth Circuit recorded this sentence in its October31,2006 opinion, Kikumura v. Hood, No.06-1110, citing the1991 Third Circuit decision. Source: https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/ca10/06-1110/06-1110-2011-03-14.html . The opinion discusses projected good-time release dates; none is substituted for the existing actual release date.

expected.name: Hedy Sawadsky
expected.description: Hedy Sawadsky joined a Christmas Day prayer protest at the Rocky Flats nuclear weapons plant near Denver on December 25, 1981. Arrested and taken to jail, the five protesters refused bond at their December 28 arraignment. A January 17, 1982 contemporary report confirms that they remained jailed after a January 8 hearing, facing contempt proceedings for violating an injunction against trespass at the plant.
expected.body: Source: National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter, January 17, 1982, page 1. Custody is historical; an exact release date has not been verified.
